title: Apple pollination costs and strategies: Trends and outlook
How to address barriers to the adoption of agricultural carbon sequestration
venue: Handbook on Climate Change Impacts, Mitigation, and Adaptation in Agriculture
abstract: On-farm carbon sequestration offers a significant opportunity to mitigate global greenhouse gas emissions and meet IPCC and UN climate goals. Challenges in coordinating action among millions of decentralized agricultural producers may make widespread implementation difficult, however. This chapter explores the potential for addressing barriers to coordinated action by leveraging recent insights from plant and soil sciences to show how economic incentives to farmers can be realigned with pro-carbon management practices, like regenerative agriculture and organic farming, that enhance the ability of soils to store atmospheric carbon. Results show that a human capital improvement, wherein farmers are fully informed about the interactions between chemical inputs, soil health, and crop yields, leads to increases in the adoption of organic management, volume of agricultural carbon sequestration, and farmer welfare. In contrast, an organic subsidy leads to smaller increases in organic adoption and farmer welfare, and moreover does not substantially increase carbon sequestration.
abstract_zh: 农场层面的碳封存为减少全球温室气体排放、实现IPCC和联合国气候目标提供了重要机会。然而，在数以百万计的分散农业生产者之间协调行动可能存在挑战，使得大范围实施较为困难。本章探讨了解决协调行动障碍的可能性：借鉴植物和土壤科学的最新见解，展示如何调整对农民的经济激励，使其与有利于碳封存的管理方式（如再生农业和有机农业）相一致，从而增强土壤储存大气碳的能力。结果表明，人力资本的提升（即农民充分了解化学投入品、土壤健康与作物产量之间的相互作用）会带动有机管理的采纳、农业碳封存量以及农民福利的提高。相比之下，有机补贴带来的有机采纳增幅较小，农民福利改善也较小，而且并未显著增加碳封存。

title: To (rent) bees or not to (rent) bees?: An examination of the farmer’s question
abstract: We‘ empirically study managed pollination demand using nationally representative farm-level data from US apple farmers. Using a shift-share instrumental variables strategy, as well as demand shocks to inform and bound demand elasticities, we undertake the first known estimate of an own-price managed pollination demand elasticity using farm-level data. We find that honey bee demand may be more elastic than prior work suggests. We reconcile these perspectives by showing that the extensive margin binary choice of whether to rent honey bees at all is relatively price inelastic and is instead driven by other factors such as crop insurance. Results also show that honey bee demand is concave in the scale of production, and that farmers seem to adjust their demand for managed pollination according to variation in local wild pollinator habitat.
abstract_zh: 我们利用具有全国代表性的美国苹果种植者农场层面数据，对人工授粉需求进行了实证研究。借助份额-移动（shift-share）工具变量策略，并利用需求冲击来约束和界定需求弹性，我们首次利用农场层面数据估计了人工授粉需求的自身价格弹性。我们发现，蜜蜂需求可能比以往研究所显示的更具弹性。我们通过证明以下结果来调和这些观点：是否租用蜜蜂这一扩展边际上的二元选择相对缺乏价格弹性，其主要受作物保险等其他因素驱动。结果还表明，蜜蜂需求在生产规模上呈凹性，并且农民会根据当地野生授粉昆虫栖息地的变化来调整其人工授粉需求。

abstract: This paper estimates a dynamic model of the world oil market and tests whether OPEC countries colluded and whether non-OPEC countries behaved oligopolistically over the period 1970-2004. Results of the analysis by decade support OPEC countries colluding as the dominant cartel producer and non-OPEC countries behaving as an oligopolistic fringe. The residual demand elasticity faced by OPEC is more elastic than the market demand elasticity, which is relatively inelastic. Market demand has become more inelastic over time over the period of study.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了世界石油市场的动态模型，并检验了1970至2004年间OPEC国家是否存在串谋，以及非OPEC国家是否表现出寡头垄断行为。分时期的分析结果支持以下结论：OPEC国家作为主导性卡特尔生产者进行了串谋，而非OPEC国家则表现为寡头垄断的边缘生产者。OPEC所面临的剩余需求弹性比市场需求弹性更大，而市场需求本身相对缺乏弹性。在研究期间，市场需求随时间推移变得越来越缺乏弹性。

Organic farming, soil health, and farmer perceptions: A dynamic structural econometric model
abstract: In some production processes, there may be an input that is advantageous in the short run but detrimental in the long run, and producers may not be fully aware of its adverse long-run effects.  One such input in the context of agricultural production are pesticides: while pesticides may have the initial effect of increasing crop yields, recent insights from soil science show that over time they exert an indirect negative effect on crop yields through their negative effects on soil health. Farmers may not be fully aware of soil microbiomes, however, and as a consequence, may not be making optimal decisions about pesticide use and organic farming adoption.  We develop and estimate a dynamic structural econometric model of farmer pesticide use decision-making to examine whether farmers are aware of and account for soil microbiomes.  Empirical results show that farmers are acting as if the clean soil stock has very little effect on crop yields, when in fact it increases yields.  We use our parameter estimates to simulate counterfactual scenarios in which farmers' beliefs about soil microbe-based ecosystem services are brought in line with findings from plant and soil sciences. We find that informing farmers about soil microbiomes decreases pesticide use, increases organic adoption, and increases farmer welfare.
abstract_zh: 在某些生产过程中，存在一种短期内有益、但长期内有害的投入品，而生产者可能并未充分意识到其长期的不利影响。在农业生产中，农药就是这样一种投入品：尽管农药最初可能提高作物产量，但土壤科学的最新研究表明，农药会通过损害土壤健康，在长期内对作物产量产生间接的负面影响。然而，农民可能并不完全了解土壤微生物群落，因此，在农药使用和有机耕作采纳方面，他们可能未作出最优决策。我们构建并估计了一个动态结构计量经济模型，用以刻画农民的农药使用决策，考察农民是否意识到并考虑了土壤微生物群落的作用。实证结果表明，农民的行为仿佛清洁土壤的存量对作物产量几乎没有影响，而事实上它确实能够提高产量。我们利用参数估计值，模拟了反事实情景：使农民对基于土壤微生物的生态系统服务的信念与植物和土壤科学的研究结论相一致。我们发现，让农民了解土壤微生物群落，将减少农药使用，提高有机耕作的采纳率，并增进农民福利。

Energy, economic growth, inequality, and poverty in Iran
abstract: This paper examines the relationships among energy consumption, economic growth, inequality, and poverty in Iran. We estimate these relationships at both the aggregate and sectoral level using instrumental variables to address endogeneity and simultaneous equation models to enhance efficiency. Results show that decreasing inequality will be beneficial for economic growth, poverty alleviation and energy access. Inequality can negatively affect GDP directly, as well as indirectly through its negative effect on energy consumption. Similarly, inequality can increase poverty both directly as well as indirectly through its negative effect on energy consumption. We also find that increasing energy consumption has multiple benefits: it increases GDP, tends to decrease inequality and decreases poverty. Energy consumption decreases poverty both directly as well as indirectly via its effect on decreasing inequality. Our results therefore suggest that policies to improve energy access are important, and will have the benefits of increasing GDP, decreasing inequality and decreasing poverty.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了伊朗能源消费、经济增长、不平等与贫困之间的关系。我们在总量和部门两个层面上，采用工具变量处理内生性问题，并采用联立方程模型提高估计效率，对这些关系进行了估计。结果表明，降低不平等将有利于经济增长、减贫和能源获取。不平等不仅会直接对GDP产生负面影响，还会通过减少能源消费间接产生负面影响。同样，不平等既会直接加剧贫困，也会通过减少能源消费间接加剧贫困。我们还发现，增加能源消费具有多重益处：它能够提高GDP，倾向于降低不平等，并减少贫困。能源消费既直接减少贫困，也通过降低不平等间接减少贫困。因此，我们的结果表明，改善能源获取的政策十分重要，并将带来提高GDP、降低不平等和减少贫困的多重益处。

Econometric modeling of the world oil market as a dynamic game
venue: Handbook of Energy Finance: Theories, Practices and Simulations
abstract: The decisions made by petroleum producers in the world oil market are both dynamic and strategic, and are thus best modeled as a dynamic game. In this chapter, we review the literature on the world oil market and discuss our research on econometric modeling of the world oil market as a dynamic game. Our research builds on the previous literature by combining three erstwhile separate dimensions of modeling the world oil market: dynamic optimization, game theory, and econometrics. Our results show that dynamic behavior and strategic interactions are important aspects of the world oil market that must be accounted for in empirical analyses of the world oil market.
abstract_zh: 石油生产者在世界石油市场上的决策兼具动态性和战略性，因此最好将其建模为动态博弈。本章回顾了关于世界石油市场的文献，并讨论了我们将世界石油市场建模为动态博弈的计量经济学研究。我们的研究通过结合三个原本相互独立的建模维度——动态优化、博弈论和计量经济学——对已有文献进行了拓展。我们的结果表明，动态行为和战略互动是世界石油市场的重要方面，在对世界石油市场进行实证分析时必须予以考虑。

title: The Chinese automobile industry and government policy
Wind turbine shutdowns and upgrades in Denmark: Timing decisions and the impact of government policy
abstract: For policymakers, an important long-run question related to the development of renewable industries is how government policies affect decisions regarding the scrapping or upgrading of existing assets. This paper develops a dynamic structural econometric model of wind turbine owners’ decisions about whether and when to add new turbines to a pre-existing stock, scrap an existing turbine, or replace old turbines with newer versions (i.e., upgrade). We apply our model to owner-level panel data for Denmark over the period 1980-2011 to estimate the underlying profit structure for small wind producers (who constitute the vast majority of turbine owners in the Danish wind industry during this time period), and evaluate the impact of technology and government policy on wind industry development. Our structural econometric model explicitly takes into account the dynamics and interdependence of shutdown and upgrade decisions, and generates parameter estimates with direct economic interpretations. Results from the model indicate that the growth and development of the Danish wind industry were driven primarily by government policies as opposed to technological improvements. We use the parameter estimates to simulate counterfactual policy scenarios in order to analyze the relative effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of the Danish feed-in-tar-iff and replacement certificate programs. Results show that both of these policies significantly impacted the timing of shutdown and upgrade decisions made by small wind producers and accelerated the development of the wind industry in Denmark. We also find that when compared with the feed-in-tariff; a declining feed-in-tariff; and the replacement certificate program and the feed-in-tariff combined, the replacement certificate program was the most cost-effective policy both for increasing payoffs of small wind producers and also for decreasing carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 对政策制定者而言，与可再生能源产业发展相关的一个重要长期问题是：政府政策如何影响现有资产报废或升级的决策。本文构建了一个动态结构计量经济模型，刻画风机所有者关于是否及何时在既有存量上增加新风机、报废现有风机，或以新型号替换旧风机（即升级）的决策。我们利用丹麦1980至2011年的所有者层面面板数据对模型进行了应用，以估计小型风力发电者（在该时期丹麦风电行业中构成绝大多数风机所有者）的潜在利润结构，并评估技术和政府政策对风电产业发展的影响。我们的结构计量模型明确考虑了停机与升级决策的动态性和相互依赖性，并生成了具有直接经济解释的参数估计值。模型结果表明，丹麦风电产业的增长与发展主要是由政府政策而非技术进步所推动的。我们利用参数估计值模拟了反事实政策情景，以分析丹麦上网电价（feed-in-tariff）和更替证书（replacement certificate）计划的相对有效性与成本效益。结果表明，这两项政策均显著影响了小型风力发电者停机与升级决策的时机，并加速了丹麦风电产业的发展。我们还发现，与上网电价、递减上网电价，以及更替证书计划与上网电价相结合的方案相比，更替证书计划是最具成本效益的政策，既最能提高小型风力发电者的收益，也最能减少碳排放。

title: Crop disease and agricultural productivity: Evidence from a dynamic structural model of Verticillium wilt management
abstract: Crop diseases and how they are managed can have a large impact on agricultural productivity. This paper discusses the effects on agricultural productivity of Verticillium dahliae, a soil borne fungus that is introduced to the soil via infested spinach seeds and that causes subsequent lettuce crops to be afflicted with Verticillium wilt. We use a dynamic structural econometric model of Verticillium wilt management for lettuce crops in Monterey County, California to examine the effects of Verticillium wilt on crop-fumigation decisions and on grower welfare. We also discuss our research on the externalities that arise with renters, and between seed companies and growers due to Verticillium wilt, as these disease-related externalities have important implications for agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 作物病害及其管理方式可能对农业生产力产生重大影响。本文探讨了黄萎病菌（Verticillium dahliae）对农业生产力的影响。这种土传真菌通过受感染的菠菜种子进入土壤，导致随后种植的生菜感染黄萎病。我们利用加利福尼亚州蒙特雷县生菜黄萎病管理的动态结构计量经济模型，考察黄萎病对土壤熏蒸决策及种植者福利的影响。我们还讨论了我们关于租户以及种子公司与种植者之间因黄萎病而产生的外部性的研究，因为这些与病害相关的外部性对农业生产力具有重要影响。

title: Spatial groundwater management: A dynamic game framework and application to California
Tradeoffs between resistance to antimicrobials in public health and their use in agriculture: Moving towards sustainability assessment
abstract: Antimicrobial use (AMU) in animal agriculture contributes to select resistant bacteria potentially transferred to humans directly or indirectly via the food chain, representing a public health hazard. Yet, a major difference triggering AMU in food animal production is that in addition to therapeutic cure, farmers use antimicrobials to keep their herds healthy and highly productive, while ensuring animal welfare and food safety objectives. As a society, we consequently face difficult tradeoffs, between massive restrictions of AMU, and maintenance of current and potentially non-sustainable consumption levels. Here, we present the different components to be addressed for assessing the sustainability of AMU in animal agriculture. At first, we describe the interests and limits of existing models identified by reviewing the literature, which could potentially be used to assess AMU sustainability, while allowing the reader to capture in a simple and visual manner the complexity of the issue. We address in the following sections the boundaries of the social-ecological system and the indicators that are required for assessment of AMU sustainability. We introduce analytic methods that could be used for assessing the sustainability of antimicrobial use.
abstract_zh: 畜牧业中的抗菌药物使用（AMU）会促使耐药细菌的选择，这些细菌可能直接或间接地通过食物链传播给人类，从而构成公共卫生隐患。然而，引发食用动物生产中抗菌药物使用的一个主要区别在于，除了治疗疾病之外，农民还使用抗菌药物来保持畜群健康、提高生产力，同时确保动物福利和食品安全目标。因此，作为一个社会，我们面临着艰难的权衡：一方面是大幅限制抗菌药物使用，另一方面是维持当前乃至可能不可持续的消费水平。本文提出了评估畜牧业中抗菌药物使用可持续性所需考虑的各个组成部分。首先，我们通过文献综述，描述了可用于评估抗菌药物使用可持续性的现有模型的意义与局限，同时使读者能够以简单直观的方式把握该问题的复杂性。随后，我们讨论了社会－生态系统的边界，以及评估抗菌药物使用可持续性所需的指标。最后，我们介绍了可用于评估抗菌药物使用可持续性的分析方法。

title: Water management and economics
venue: The Routledge Handbook of Agricultural Economics
abstract: The sustainable management of groundwater resources for use in agriculture is a critical issue worldwide. Many of the world’s most productive agricultural basins depend on groundwater and have experienced declines in water table levels. The food consumers eat, the farmers who produce that food, and the local economies supporting that production are all affected by the availability of groundwater. Increasing competition for water for cities and for environmental needs, as well as concerns about future climate variability and more frequent droughts, have caused policy makers to look for ways to decrease the consumptive use of water. In this chapter, we discuss the economics of sustainable agricultural groundwater management, including the importance of dynamic management; the importance of spatial management; the possible perverse consequences of incentive-based agricultural groundwater conservation programs; property rights; the groundwater–energy nexus; and the effects of climate change. JEL classifications: Q15, Q30, Q25
abstract_zh: 农业用地地下水资源的可持续管理，是全球范围内的关键问题。世界上许多生产力最高的农业流域都依赖地下水，并且已经出现了地下水位下降的情况。消费者所吃的食物、生产这些食物的农民，以及支撑该生产的当地经济，都受到地下水可获得性的影响。城市和环境用水需求日益增长，以及对未来气候变率和更频繁干旱的担忧，促使政策制定者寻找减少水资源消耗性使用的方法。在本章中，我们讨论了农业地下水可持续管理的经济学，包括动态管理的重要性、空间管理的重要性、基于激励的农业地下水保护计划可能产生的反常后果、产权，以及水－能源关联（groundwater–energy nexus），还有气候变化的影响。JEL分类号：Q15, Q30, Q25

title: A review of control options and externalities for Verticillium wilts
Designing climate policy: Lessons from the Renewable Fuel Standard and the blend wall
abstract: Many policies mandate renewable energy production to combat global climate change. These policies often differ significantly from first‐best policy prescriptions. Among the largest renewable energy mandates enacted to date is the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), which mandates biofuel consumption far beyond what is feasible with current technology and infrastructure. We critically review the methods used by the Environmental Protection Agency to project near‐ and long‐term compliance costs under the RFS, and draw lessons from the RFS experience to date that would improve the program's efficiency. The lessons are meant to inform both future RFS rulemaking and the design of future climate policies. We draw two lessons specific to the RFS. First, incorporate uncertainty into rulemaking; second, implement multi‐year rules. Multi‐year rulemaking allows for longer periods between major regulatory decisions and sends greater certainty to markets. We also provide two more general recommendations: tie waiver authority to compliance costs or include cost containment provisions, and fund research and development of new technologies directly rather than mandating them. Future technological advancement is uncertain, and mandating new technologies has proven to be largely ineffective to date, particularly in fuel markets.
abstract_zh: 许多政策要求强制生产可再生能源以应对全球气候变化。这些政策往往与最优政策处方存在显著差异。迄今为止颁布的最大规模可再生能源强制性要求之一是《可再生燃料标准》（RFS），该标准要求的生物燃料消费量远超现有技术和基础设施所能达到的水平。我们批判性地回顾了美国环境保护署（EPA）在RFS下预测近期与长期合规成本所采用的方法，并从迄今为止的RFS经验中总结教训，以提高该计划的效率。这些教训既旨在为未来的RFS规则制定提供参考，也旨在为未来气候政策的设计提供借鉴。我们得出两条针对RFS的具体教训：第一，在规则制定中纳入不确定性；第二，实施多年期规则。多年期规则制定可以拉长重大监管决策之间的间隔，并向市场提供更大的确定性。我们还提出两条更一般性的建议：将豁免权限与合规成本挂钩或纳入成本控制条款，以及直接资助新技术的研发，而非强制使用这些技术。未来的技术进步具有不确定性，迄今为止，强制使用新技术的做法已被证明基本无效，在燃料市场中尤其如此。

title: Jevons’ Paradox and efficient irrigation technology
abstract: Water is one of our world’s most essential natural resources, but it is also a resource that is becoming increasingly scarce. The agricultural use of groundwater is particularly important to manage sustainably and well. However, popular and well-intentioned water conservation and management policies, including those that encourage the adoption of more efficient irrigation technology, may have unintended and possibly perverse consequences if policy-makers do not account for water users’ behavioral responses to their policies. In particular, a Jevons’ Paradox may arise, whereby a technology that enhances the efficiency of using a natural resource does not necessarily lead to less consumption of that resource. In this paper, we discuss efficient irrigation technology, Jevons’ Paradox, and the possible perverse consequences of incentive-based programs for agricultural groundwater conservation.
abstract_zh: 水是世界上最基本的自然资源之一，但它也正变得日益稀缺。农业对地下水的利用尤其需要进行可持续且妥善的管理。然而，流行且出于良好意愿的水资源保护与管理政策，包括鼓励采用更高效灌溉技术的政策，如果政策制定者不考虑用水者对政策的行为反应，可能会产生意想不到的甚至适得其反的后果。尤其可能出现“杰文斯悖论”（Jevons’ Paradox），即提高自然资源利用效率的技术，并不一定导致该资源消费量的减少。本文讨论了高效灌溉技术、杰文斯悖论，以及基于激励的农业地下水保护计划可能产生的反常后果。

title: Migration in rural Mexico: Strategic interactions, dynamic behavior, and the environment

Policy shocks and market-based regulations: Evidence from the Renewable Fuel Standard
abstract: The Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS2) mandates large increases in U.S. biofuel consumption and is implemented using a market for tradable compliance credits, known as RINs. In early 2013, RIN prices soared, causing the regulator to propose reducing future mandates. We develop a dynamic model of RFS2 compliance to demonstrate how changes in expectations about future policy affect current compliance costs, and we use a market effciency test to demonstrate that RIN markets have behaved in accordance with our model. We then estimate empirically the effect of three "policy shocks" that reduced the expected mandates in 2013. The largest of these shocks decreased the total cost of compliance by nearly $8 billion. The burden of the mandate reductions fell primarily on advanced biofuel firms and on commodity markets of the marginal compliance biofuel. We argue that the policy shocks reduced the incentive to invest in the technologies required to meet the future objectives of the RFS2. JEL Codes: Q42, Q50, H23
abstract_zh: 《可再生燃料标准》（RFS2）要求美国生物燃料消费量大幅增长，并通过一个可交易合规额度（称为RIN）的市场来实施。2013年初，RIN价格飙升，促使监管机构提议降低未来的强制配额。我们构建了一个RFS2合规的动态模型，以说明对未来政策预期的变化如何影响当前的合规成本；并使用市场效率检验来证明RIN市场的行为与我们的模型相符。随后，我们以实证方法估计了2013年三次降低预期强制配额的“政策冲击”的效应。其中最大的一次冲击使合规总成本减少了近80亿美元。配额降低的负担主要落在先进生物燃料企业以及边际合规生物燃料的商品市场上。我们认为，这些政策冲击削弱了企业投资于实现RFS2未来目标所需技术的激励。JEL分类号：Q42, Q50, H23

title: The economics of agricultural groundwater management institutions: The case of California
abstract: The sustainable management of groundwater resources for use in agriculture is a critical issue in California and globally. Many of the world’s most productive agricultural basins depend on groundwater and have experienced declines in water table levels. The food consumers eat, the farmers who produce that food, and the local economies supporting that production are all affected by the availability of groundwater. Increasing competition for water from cities and environmental needs, as well as concerns about future climate variability and more frequent droughts, has caused policy-makers to look for ways to decrease the consumptive use of water. When designing groundwater management policies and institutions, it is important to consider any possible perverse consequences from the policy. In this paper, we discuss the economics of sustainable agricultural groundwater management institutions, including the possible perverse consequences of incentive-based agricultural groundwater conservation programs; the importance of dynamic management, conjunctive management, and spatial management; and property rights.
abstract_zh: 农业用地地下水资源的可持续管理，在加利福尼亚州乃至全球都是一个关键问题。世界上许多生产力最高的农业流域都依赖地下水，并且已经出现了地下水位下降的情况。消费者所吃的食物、生产这些食物的农民，以及支撑该生产的当地经济，都受到地下水可获得性的影响。城市和环境用水需求的增长，以及对未来气候变率和更频繁干旱的担忧，促使政策制定者寻找减少水资源消耗性使用的方法。在设计地下水管理政策和制度时，必须考虑政策可能产生的任何反常后果。在本文中，我们讨论了农业地下水可持续管理制度的经济学，包括基于激励的农业地下水保护计划可能产生的反常后果；动态管理、联合管理和空间管理的重要性；以及产权问题。

On the rate of return and risk factors to international oil companies in Iran's buy-back service contracts
abstract: We analyze the rate of return (ROR) and risk factors faced by Shell Exploration, an international oil company (IOC), in its Soroosh and Nowrooz buy-back service contract in Iran. In particular, based on our models of cash flow, we analyze the buy-back contract specific risk factors that can contribute to a reduction in the rate of return for the international oil company. Our actual and contractual cash flow models reveal that Shell Exploration’s actual ROR was much lower than the contractual level. Furthermore, we find that among the risk factors that we considered, a capital cost overrun has the greatest negative effect on the IOC’s ROR. Moreover, we show that there is a potential for modifying the contracts in order for the IOC to face an actual ROR closer to the contractual ROR even if the contract faces cost overrun or delay, without exceeding the maximum contractual ROR that the National Iranian Oil Company is willing to give.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了壳牌勘探公司（Shell Exploration，一家国际石油公司，IOC）在伊朗Soroosh和Nowrooz回购服务合同中面临的收益率（ROR）及风险因素。特别地，基于我们的现金流模型，我们分析了回购合同中可能导致国际石油公司收益率下降的具体风险因素。我们的实际与合同现金流模型显示，壳牌勘探公司的实际收益率远低于合同约定水平。此外，在我们所考虑的风险因素中，资本成本超支对该国际石油公司收益率的负面影响最大。而且，我们表明，即使合同面临成本超支或延误，仍有可能对合同进行修改，使该国际石油公司面临的实际收益率更接近合同收益率，同时又不超过伊朗国家石油公司愿意给予的最高合同收益率。

title: The effects of urban public transit investment on traffic congestion and air quality
abstract: Traffic congestion is ubiquitous across urban roadways, and the adverse health effects accompanying deteriorating air quality are an ongoing concern. Beyond these local effects, transportation is also a major contributor of greenhouse gas emissions and is thus a significant element of the climate change debate. A contentious issue currently confronting transportation analysts and policy-makers is what the effects of public transit investment on traffic congestion and on air quality are and therefore what the appropriate level of public transit investment should be. While public transit receives plenty of political support for its “green” reputation and its contribution to sustainability, there have been relatively few studies examining the ex post–effects of public transit investment on traffic congestion or air quality. In this chapter, we review our theoretical and empirical research on the effects of public transit investment on congestion, the demand for automobile travel, and air quality.
abstract_zh: 城市交通拥堵无处不在，随之而来的空气质量恶化所带来的健康危害也持续引起关注。除了这些局部影响之外，交通运输也是温室气体排放的主要来源，因此是气候变化讨论中的重要环节。目前交通分析人员和政策制定者面临的一个有争议的问题是：公共交通投资对交通拥堵和空气质量有何影响，进而公共交通投资的适当规模应当是多少。尽管公共交通因其“绿色”声誉及其对可持续发展的贡献而获得了大量政治支持，但考察公共交通投资对交通拥堵或空气质量的事后影响的研究相对较少。在本章中，我们回顾了我们关于公共交通投资对拥堵、汽车出行需求和空气质量影响的理论与实证研究。

title: The macroeconomic rebound effect in China
Bending the curve: Ten scalable solutions for carbon neutrality and climate stability
venue: Bending the Curve: Ten scalable solutions for carbon neutrality and climate stability
abstract: We are living in a world of over seven billion people, with annual greenhouse gas emissions of approximately 50 billion tons a year and rising steadily. If continued unabated, the world is on target to warm by about 2 °C in less than 40 years, pushing the climate to a regime unlike any that has been witnessed in the last million years. Nonetheless, we still have time to avert such a catastrophic scenario, or delay its occurrence by several decades to provide human societies and the ecosystem with the time to adjust. In order to mitigate the possibility of climate disruption, we need to recognize that fossil fuel based technologies have become outdated and transform the energy system to that of low-carbon, sustainable and secure energy systems. In addition, we have to mitigate emissions of the four short-lived climate pollutants to bring immediate relief from climate change and protect vulnerable societies. Stability of the climate system involves not only the centrality of scientific and technological advancements and investments, but also necessary shifts in social structure and behavior by individuals, communities and societies worldwide as well as market based instruments, sub-national collaborations and governance structure. Fortunately, living laboratories—such as the State of California and the University of California system, which has pledged to become carbon neutral by 2025—provide demonstrable solutions which hold promise in alleviating the climate warming in the next generation. These jurisdictions are tiny emitters in the global picture, but they offer the potential for leverage through demonstrating (Figure 1) new technologies as well as workable institutions that cut emissions. We outline 10 pragmatic solutions—a “kit of parts” rooted in California but scalable to the world—that taken together, can “bend the curve” of the upward trajectory of human-caused warming trends. Wholesale transformation of our current fossil fuel based energy systems towards sustainable energy is among the greatest of societal challenges—and opportunities—faced in the 21st century.
abstract_zh: 我们生活在一个超过七十亿人口的世界中，每年的温室气体排放量约为500亿吨，并且仍在稳步上升。如果任其持续而不加遏制，世界将在不到40年内升温约2 °C，使气候进入过去一百万年从未见过的状态。尽管如此，我们仍有时间避免这一灾难性情景，或将其推迟数十年，从而为人类社会和生态系统提供适应的时间。为降低气候系统紊乱的可能性，我们需要认识到以化石燃料为基础的技术已经过时，并将能源系统转型为低碳、可持续且安全的能源系统。此外，我们必须减缓四种短寿命气候污染物的排放，以便立即缓解气候变化并保护脆弱社会。气候系统的稳定不仅取决于科学技术进步与投资的核心地位，还取决于个人、社区和社会在全球范围内的社会结构与行为的必要转变，以及市场化工具、次国家层面合作和治理结构的作用。幸运的是，加利福尼亚州以及承诺将于2025年实现碳中和的加州大学系统等“生活实验室”，提供了切实可行的解决方案，有望在下一代缓解气候变暖。这些司法辖区在全球排放格局中所占比例很小，但它们有潜力通过示范（图1）新技术以及切实可行、能够减排的制度而产生杠杆效应。我们提出了10项务实的解决方案，即一套以加利福尼亚为基础、但可推广至全球的“组件包”，这些方案结合起来，可以“扭转”人类活动导致的变暖趋势的上升曲线。将当前以化石燃料为基础的能源系统全面转向可持续能源，是21世纪人类社会面临的最大挑战之一，同时也是机遇。

title: The management of groundwater: Irrigation efficiency, policy, institutions, and externalities
abstract: The management of groundwater resources for use in agriculture is an issue that reaches far and wide; many of the world's most productive agricultural basins depend on groundwater and have experienced declines in water table levels. There is a socially optimal rate of extraction that can be modeled, measured, and achieved through policy and a complete definition of the property rights that govern groundwater. However, several factors may affect farmers' groundwater use decisions and behavior and may lead them to overextract groundwater. These factors include increases in irrigation efficiency, perverse incentives from policy, institutional incentives, and externalities.
abstract_zh: 用于农业的地下水资源管理是一个影响广泛的问题；世界上许多生产力最高的农业流域依赖地下水，且地下水位已经下降。存在一个社会最优的开采率，这一开采率可以通过建模、测量，并通过政策以及对地下水产权的完整界定来实现。然而，有若干因素可能影响农民的地下水使用决策和行为，并可能导致他们过度抽取地下水。这些因素包括灌溉效率的提高、政策中的反向激励、制度性激励以及外部性。

title: Measuring benefits from a marketing cooperative in the Copper River Fishery
abstract: The degradation of product quality is one form of rent dissipation resulting from incomplete property rights in fisheries. Industry structure and information asymmetries can also lead to underinvestment in product quality, even when property rights are well defined. In this article we empirically examine whether the voluntary formation of a marketing cooperative was able to mitigate market failures that led to the production of inferior‐quality fish. Specifically, we use a difference‐in‐differences estimation strategy to measure the impact that the Copper River Fishermen's Cooperative, an Alaskan salmon marketing cooperative, had on ex‐vessel salmon prices and salmon quality measures. We find that the cooperative was able to improve product quality, as well as attract and sustain a higher price for its salmon. Our findings provide empirical support for many of the key tenets of cooperative theory. Specifically, we find evidence that marketing cooperatives can address existing market failures, that marketing cooperatives can have advantages in high‐quality product markets, and that over time, as a result of their success, marketing cooperatives may lead to lasting producer benefits even though they become obsolete due to nonmember free‐riding.
abstract_zh: 产品质量下降是渔业产权不完整所导致的一种租金耗散形式。即使产权界定清晰，行业结构和信息不对称也可能导致对产品质量的投资不足。在本文中，我们实证检验了自愿组建的营销合作社能否缓解导致劣质鱼产品生产的市场失灵。具体而言，我们采用双重差分估计策略，衡量阿拉斯加鲑鱼营销合作社——铜河渔民合作社（Copper River Fishermen's Cooperative）——对船边鲑鱼价格和鲑鱼质量指标的影响。我们发现，该合作社能够提升产品质量，并为其鲑鱼吸引和维持更高的价格。我们的研究结果为合作社理论的许多核心观点提供了实证支持。具体而言，我们发现有证据表明，营销合作社能够解决现存的市场失灵，在高质量产品市场中具有优势，并且随着其取得成功，营销合作社即使因非成员搭便车而变得过时，仍可能带来持久的生产者收益。

The effects of energy prices on agricultural groundwater extraction from the High Plains Aquifer
abstract: We examine the effects of energy prices on groundwater extraction using an econometric model of a farmer's irrigation water pumping decision that accounts for both the intensive and extensive margins. Our results show that energy prices have an effect on both types of margins. Increasing energy prices would affect crop selection decisions, crop acreage allocation decisions, and farmers' demand for water. Our estimated total marginal effect, which sums the effects on the intensive and extensive margins, suggests that a $1 per million btu increase in the energy price would decrease water extraction by an individual farmer by 5.89 acre‐feet per year, a decrease of 3.6 percent of the average annual extraction rate. Our estimated elasticity of water extraction with respect to energy price is −0.26.
abstract_zh: 我们使用一个农民灌溉抽水决策的计量经济模型考察能源价格对地下水开采的影响，该模型同时考虑了集约边际和广延边际。结果表明，能源价格对两种边际均有影响。能源价格上涨将影响作物选择决策、作物种植面积分配决策以及农民的用水需求。我们估计的总边际效应是集约边际与广延边际效应之和，结果表明，能源价格每上涨每百万英热单位1美元，将使单个农民的年度取水量减少5.89英亩-英尺，相当于平均年度开采率下降3.6%。我们估计的地下水开采量相对于能源价格的弹性为−0.26。

title: The optimal gasoline tax for China
abstract: Gasoline-powered vehicles produce many negative externalities including congestion, air pollution, global climate change, and accidents. A gasoline tax is perhaps the best policy to jointly address these externalities. This paper calculates the optimal gasoline tax for China. Using a model developed by Parry and Small [1] 08D0C9EA79F9BACE118C8200AA004BA90B02000000080000000E0000005F005200650066003300380035003600300030003200350032000000 [2] 08D0C9EA79F9BACE118C8200AA004BA90B02000000080000000E0000005F005200650066003300380035003600300030003200350036000000 , we calculate the optimal adjusted Pigovian tax in China to be $1.58/gallon which is 2.65 times more than the current level. Of the externalities incorporated in this Pigovian tax, the congestion costs are taxed the most heavily, at $0.82/gallon, followed by local air pollution, accident externalities, and finally global climate change.

title: An analysis of ethanol investment decisions in Thailand
California’s agriculture-related air pollution policy
abstract: Air pollution is a critical environmental issue for California, which has some of the nation’s most polluted air basins and also the nation’s most stringent set of state and local air quality standards. This paper reviews my previous work in Lin (2011), in which I examine the effects of agriculture-related local regulations in California on air quality, as measured by the number of exceedances of the CO and NO2 standards, by exploiting the natural variation in policy among the different air districts in California. Agricultural burning policies and penalty fees reduce the pollution from CO. Other policies such as the prohibition on visible emission, fugitive dust, particulate matter, nitrogen and the reduction of animal matter are correlated with higher levels of CO. Regulations on orchard and citrus heaters have no significant effect on the number of exceedances of the CO and NO2 standards.
abstract_zh: 空气污染是加利福尼亚面临的关键环境问题，该州拥有全美污染最严重的空气流域之一，同时也拥有全美最严格的州级和地方空气质量标准。本文回顾了我在Lin（2011）中的既有工作，该研究利用加利福尼亚各空气管理区之间政策的自然差异，考察了加州与农业相关的地方法规对空气质量的影响，空气质量以CO和NO2标准的超标次数衡量。农业焚烧政策和罚款制度降低了CO污染。而其他政策，如禁止可见排放、扬尘、颗粒物、氮以及减少动物排泄物等，则与较高的CO水平相关。针对果园和柑橘园加热器的监管对CO和NO2标准超标次数没有显著影响。

title: Endogeneity in the environmental Kuznets curve: An instrumental variables approach
abstract: The effects of increasing income on environmental quality is an issue that has long puzzled economists. For over a decade, economists have theorized that a graph of environmental degradation versus income often looks something approximating an inverted-U shape, dubbed the environmental Kuznets curve (EKC) after Simon Kuznets' work in the 1950s and 1960s on income equality (Kuznets 1955(Kuznets , 1965)).Among the reasons why economists have found the effects of increasing income on environmental quality so intriguing is that the answers to this question would help resolve fundamental issues concerning humanity's ability to develop economically, while still preserving the environment. Some economists hypothesize that there is a causal relationship between income and environmental degradation, and that the relation is in the shape of an inverted U: as countries "get rich, … first [environmental] problems increase, and then they decrease" (Lomborg and Pope 2003, p. 9).According to this theory, the solution to environmental problems is to alleviate poverty.
abstract_zh: 收入增长对环境质量的影响，是一个长期困扰经济学家的问题。十多年来，经济学家一直认为，环境退化与收入的关系图通常近似呈倒U形，这一曲线因西蒙·库兹涅茨（Simon Kuznets）在20世纪50年代和60年代关于收入不平等的研究而被称为环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）（Kuznets 1955(Kuznets , 1965)）。经济学家之所以对收入增长对环境质量的影响如此感兴趣，原因在于，这一问题的答案将有助于解决人类在保护环境的同时实现经济发展能力的根本问题。一些经济学家假设收入与环境退化之间存在因果关系，且这种关系呈倒U形：国家“变富的过程中……起初[环境]问题增加，然后减少”（Lomborg and Pope 2003, p. 9）。根据这一理论，解决环境问题的办法在于消除贫困。

title: Gasoline price volatility and the elasticity of demand for gasoline
New approach to modeling large- scale transitions to alternative fuels and vehicles
abstract: A large-scale transition to alternative fuels and vehicles is challenging. New modeling approaches are necessary to supplement existing models, such as MARKAL. One promising approach is simulation gaming. Simulation gaming has been used extensively in many fields, most conspicuously in military applications, to provide insights into the dynamics of uncertain processes. A large-scale game to simulate transitions to alternative fuels and vehicles was developed to explore the potential of this approach. Preliminary results of the game play suggest a possible counterintuitive dynamic: high energy prices can discourage the wide-scale adoption of alternative fuel vehicles because increased fuel costs reduce consumers' ability to pay for more costly alternative vehicle technologies.
abstract_zh: 大规模向替代燃料和替代汽车转型具有挑战性。需要新的建模方法来补充现有模型，例如MARKAL。一种颇有前景的方法是模拟博弈。模拟博弈已在许多领域得到广泛应用，其中最突出的是军事应用，用于洞察不确定过程的动态。我们开发了一个大规模博弈，用以模拟向替代燃料和替代汽车的转型，以探索这一方法的潜力。博弈的初步结果提示了一种可能的反直觉动态：高能源价格可能阻碍替代燃料汽车的大规模普及，因为燃料成本的上升会降低消费者购买更昂贵替代汽车技术的能力。

title: Tax policy can change the production path: A model of optimal oil extraction in Alaska
Using spatial econometrics to measure ozone pollution externalities
abstract: This paper summarizes my previous work in Lin (2010), in which I use spatial econometrics to analyze air pollution externalities. In Lin (2010), state-by-state source-receptor transfer coefficients that can be used as a basis for a location- differentiated permit system are estimated. Results affirm the importance of regional transport in determining local ozone air quality, although owing to non-monotonicities in ozone production the externality is not always negative. Because the origin of emissions matters, results also reject a non-spatially differentiated NOx cap and trade program as an appropriate mechanism for reducing ozone smog.
abstract_zh: 本文总结了我在Lin（2010）中的既有工作，该研究利用空间计量经济学分析空气污染外部性。在Lin（2010）中，我们估计了可作为基于地点差异化排污许可制度基础的分州源—受体传输系数。结果证实了区域传输在决定本地臭氧空气质量中的重要性，尽管由于臭氧生成的非单调性，该外部性并非总是负的。由于排放来源具有重要意义，结果还表明，不区分空间的NOx总量控制与交易计划并不是降低臭氧烟雾的适当机制。

title: The investment timing game in petroleum production: An econometric model
Trends in exceedances of the ozone air quality standard in the continental United States, 1980-1998
Increasing background ozone in surface air over the United States
abstract: The long‐term trend of background O3 in surface air over the United States from 1980 to 1998 is examined using monthly probability distributions of daily maximum 8‐hour average O3 concentrations at a large ensemble of rural sites. Ozone concentrations have decreased at the high end of the probability distribution (reflecting emission controls) but have increased at the low end. The cross‐over takes place between the 30th and 50th percentiles in May–August and between the 60th and 90th percentiles during the rest of the year. The increase is statistically significant at a 5% level in spring and fall, when it is 3–5 ppbv. The maximum increase is in the Northeast. A possible explanation is an increase in the O3 background transported from outside the United States. Better understanding of the causes of the increase is needed because of its implications for meeting O3 air quality standards.
abstract_zh: 利用一大组农村站点的日最大8小时平均O3浓度的月度概率分布，本文考察了1980年至1998年美国地表空气中背景O3的长期趋势。臭氧浓度在概率分布的高端有所下降（反映了排放控制），但在低端却有所上升。这一交叉点在5月至8月位于第30至第50百分位之间，而在一年中其余时间则位于第60至第90百分位之间。在春季和秋季，增幅在5%的显著性水平上具有统计显著性，增幅为3–5 ppbv。最大增幅出现在东北部地区。一种可能的解释是，来自美国境外的传输背景臭氧有所增加。由于该增加对实现臭氧空气质量标准具有重要意义，因此需要更好地理解其成因。
